title: Nokwarefoɔ a wɔwɔ Makkah
intro: Wɔ adiyisɛm mfiase no mu, bere a nokware nkrasɛm no hyiaa ɔsɔretia a emu yɛ den no, akra binom gyinaa hɔ a wonhinhim wɔ wɔn gyidi mu. Saa agyidifo yi hyiaa atirimɔdensɛm a wontumi nsusuw ho fii wɔn a wɔhwehwɛe sɛ wobedum gyidi hann no hɔ. Na wɔn ayayade no mu yɛ den, na wɔn amanehunu no yɛ kɛse —nanso wɔn tɛkrɛma annyae da sɛ wɔbɛbɔ Allah Baakoyɛ ho dawuru. Bere a wɔtoo wɔn guu abasamtu bun mu mpo no, ɔsoro ahobammɔ twaa wɔn ho hyiae, na ɛdanee wɔn sɔhwɛ no yɛɛ no ​​gyidi adanse a enni awiei. Momma yɛnhwehwɛ akra a wɔn ho yɛ nwonwa yi akwantu mu.
clues: Wɔde asotwe a emu yɛ den sɔɔ yɛn hwɛe esiane sɛ yɛpow sɛ yebegyae gyidi a yɛwɔ wɔ Onyankopɔn Baako no mu nti
Yɛn nkurɔfo no antumi ansɛe yɛn bo a yɛasi no, ɛmfa ho sɛnea wɔn atirimɔdensɛm no bɛyɛɛ adebɔ
Ná wɔde yɛn sɛn abura bi mu awia, nanso na ɔsoro mmoa bɛn yɛn bere nyinaa
Yɛn pintinnyɛ no maa wɔn a wohuu yɛn boasetɔ no mpo ho dwiriw wɔn
Nnipa pii a wɔwɔ Makkah hwehwɛɛ sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ yɛn ma yɛatwe yɛn ho, nanso yɛkɔɔ so sii yɛn bo
Bere a na ɛte sɛ nea ne nyinaa ayera no, yɛn ahofadi no nam anwonwakwan so ɔsoro de ne ho gyee mu so bae

trial.label: Sɔhwɛ/Asɛm a esii
options: Ɔtaa esiane sɛ wɔpow sɛ wɔbɛsom abosom nti
Gyidi ho sɔhwɛ a ɛfa ogya a esii no ho
Anadwo akwantu a emu apaapae no ho sɔhwɛ
trial.answer: Ɔtaa esiane sɛ wɔpow sɛ wɔbɛsom abosom nti

outcome.label: Nsunsuansoɔ
options: Nkonimdi wɔ ɔko kɛse bi mu
Ahofadi a ɛnam ɔsoro de ne ho gye mu so
Gye a wogye tom kɔ paradise tẽẽ
Tu a wotu kɔ asase a nhyira wom so
outcome.answer: Ahofadi a ɛnam ɔsoro de ne ho gye mu so
